newsitem.title: JAPAN: Sekisui Plastics shares fall on downgrading.
newsitem.headline: Sekisui Plastics shares fall on downgrading.

text.p: Shares in Sekisui Plastics Co Ltd slipped on Monday morning, mainly discouraged by a major securities house's downgrading of the issue earlier in the morning, traders said.
The share price lost 12 yen to 500 yen by 0228 GMT, on volume of 42,000 shares.
The share price of the foam plastics manufacturer briefly fell to 488 yen, matching its previous low for this year.

Earlier in the morning, Nomura Research Institute Ltd downgraded Sekisui Plastics to a "3" rating from its previous "2". In its three-grade rating system, the institute assigns a "3" rating to issues whose values it expects will underperform the key 225-share Nikkei average by more than 10 percentage points over the following six months.
Nomura said the downgrading was due to worse-than-expected earnings in Sekisui Plastics' subsidiary.
